summary: Frontend-only visual QA of TMI product-detail pages after image swaps. Verified 6 category pages (antivuelco, cubiertas, ajustables, placas, medida, mecanizado) plus index. Confirmed the 3 critical image swaps (Anclaje Oculto=p17_img02, AOculto 100=p21_img03, Argollas=argolla_real.png) render correctly on white/light background with piece alone (no concrete/panel/assembly context, no plans/dimensions/arrows). No JS errors on any page.

issues: 'Solución a Medida' (p85_img01.jpeg) is a 3D CAD rendering on a DARK background rather than a real photo on white. It is a piece alone (no context/plan), so it does not violate the user's 'no context / no plans' rule, but it is inconsistent with the rest of the catalog which uses white-background photos. Consider replacing with a white-background photo for visual consistency.

'Z Correa (ZC)' (p71_img02.png) and 'Z Cubierta' (p72_img03.png) appear visually IDENTICAL (same L-shaped bracket, both ~184KB). Comment in data.js line 46 claims Z Cubierta should be 'diferente a ZCC' but visually it is the same as Z Correa. Not a violation of the rule, but two different products share the same picture.
'Escuadra Fresada 50x8' and 'Escuadra Fresada Interior 80x8' both use p51_img01.png (duplicated). Also 'Escuadra Fresada Refuerzo 80x8' and 'Escuadras 80x8 a Medida' both use p63_img03.png.
